functions.name: IRLgAc::setPower
functions.description: Set the internal power state flag (on/off) for the LG A/C command being built.
requirements: on selects power state; true = on, false = off.
Does not transmit until send() is called.

functions.name: IRLgAc::getPower
functions.description: Return the current internal power state flag for the LG A/C command.

functions.name: IRLgAc::isOffCommand
functions.description: Return true if the stored command corresponds to the dedicated LG A/C Off command pattern.
requirements: Relies on the currently stored raw state.

functions.name: IRLgAc::setTemp
functions.description: Set the target temperature (in Celsius) in the internal LG A/C state.
requirements: degrees should be within the supported range: kLgAcMinTemp (16 C) to kLgAcMaxTemp (30 C). Values outside may be clamped or rejected depending on implementation.
Only updates internal state until send() is called.

functions.name: IRLgAc::getTemp
functions.description: Get the target temperature (in Celsius) stored in the current LG A/C state.

functions.name: IRLgAc::setFan
functions.description: Set the fan speed code in the internal LG A/C state. Supports discrete speeds and Auto, matching LG protocol codes.
requirements: speed must be one of the defined LG fan codes, e.g., kLgAcFanAuto(5), kLgAcFanLowest(0), kLgAcFanLow(1), kLgAcFanMedium(2), kLgAcFanHigh(10), kLgAcFanMax(4), or other documented codes for specific models.
Only updates internal state until send() is called.

functions.name: IRLgAc::getFan
functions.description: Return the current raw LG fan speed code stored in the internal state.

functions.name: IRLgAc::setMode
functions.description: Set the operating mode for the LG A/C command (Cool, Dry, Fan, Auto, Heat) using the LG protocol mode codes.
requirements: mode must be one of the LG mode codes: kLgAcCool(0), kLgAcDry(1), kLgAcFan(2), kLgAcAuto(3), kLgAcHeat(4).
Only updates internal state until send() is called.

functions.name: IRLgAc::getMode
functions.description: Get the raw LG mode code currently stored in the internal state.

functions.name: IRLgAc::setLight
functions.description: Set the AC unit’s display light state (on/off) where supported by the LG protocol and model.
requirements: Effect depends on remote model; some models use a Light toggle command.
Only updates internal state until send() is called.

functions.name: IRLgAc::getLight
functions.description: Return the stored display light state flag (if tracked) in the internal state.

functions.name: IRLgAc::isLightToggle
functions.description: Return true if the currently stored command corresponds to the LG Light toggle command pattern.
requirements: Depends on model support; only meaningful for models with light toggle capability.

functions.name: IRLgAc::isSwing
functions.description: Return true if the stored command is a Swing-related command (vertical or horizontal) rather than a standard state frame.
requirements: Interprets the current raw state; meaning depends on model and swing command family.

functions.name: IRLgAc::setSwingH
functions.description: Enable or disable horizontal swing (SwingH) in the internal state for models that support it.
requirements: on selects horizontal swing enable or off.
Support varies by model (e.g., AKB73757604 constants exist).

functions.name: IRLgAc::getSwingH
functions.description: Return the stored horizontal swing enable flag from the internal state.

functions.name: IRLgAc::isSwingV
functions.description: Return true if the stored command is a vertical swing (SwingV) command code.
requirements: Interprets the current raw state against swing-V signatures.

functions.name: IRLgAc::isSwingVToggle
functions.description: Return true if the stored command is the vertical swing toggle code.
requirements: Uses known SwingV toggle constants (e.g., kLgAcSwingVToggle).

functions.name: IRLgAc::isVaneSwingV
functions.description: Return true if the stored command is a per-vane vertical swing position command (multi-vane models).
requirements: Relevant only for models that support per-vane SwingV positions.

functions.name: IRLgAc::setSwingV
functions.description: Set the vertical swing command or position code in the internal state using LG swing constants (e.g., specific louver positions, Swing, Off).
requirements: position must be one of the defined SwingV constants, e.g., kLgAcSwingVLowest, kLgAcSwingVLow, kLgAcSwingVMiddle, kLgAcSwingVUpperMiddle, kLgAcSwingVHigh, kLgAcSwingVHighest, kLgAcSwingVSwing (Auto), or kLgAcSwingVOff.
Only updates internal state until send() is called.
Model support for some positions may vary.

functions.name: IRLgAc::getSwingV
functions.description: Get the current vertical swing command/position code stored in the internal state.

functions.name: IRLgAc::setVaneSwingV
functions.signature: void IRLgAc::setVaneSwingV(const uint8_t vane, const uint8_t position)
functions.description: Set the vertical swing position for a specific vane (multi-vane models) in the internal state using the per-vane position codes.
requirements: vane must be a valid vane index in [0, kLgAcSwingVMaxVanes - 1] (max 4 vanes).
position should be one of the per-vane position codes: kLgAcVaneSwingVHighest(1) to kLgAcVaneSwingVLowest(6), or other model-supported values.
Only updates internal state until send() is called.
Applicable only on models that support per-vane control.

functions.name: IRLgAc::getVaneSwingV
functions.description: Get the stored vertical swing position code for the specified vane index.
requirements: vane must be a valid index in [0, kLgAcSwingVMaxVanes - 1].

functions.name: IRLgAc::calcVaneSwingV
functions.signature: static uint32_t IRLgAc::calcVaneSwingV(const uint8_t vane, const uint8_t position)
functions.description: Compute the raw SwingV command code for a given vane index and position for models supporting per-vane control. Useful for crafting raw commands or validating inputs.
requirements: vane must be a valid index in [0, kLgAcSwingVMaxVanes - 1].
position should be one of the per-vane position codes (1..6 as defined by kLgAcVaneSwingV*).

functions.name: IRLgAc::getVaneCode
functions.description: Extract and return the per-vane position code from a raw SwingV command value.
requirements: raw must be a valid LG SwingV raw code for which a vane code can be extracted.

functions.name: IRLgAc::isSwingH
functions.description: Return true if the stored command is a horizontal swing (SwingH) command code.
requirements: Interprets the current raw state against SwingH signatures (e.g., kLgAcSwingHAuto/kLgAcSwingHOff).

functions.name: IRLgAc::updateSwingPrev
functions.description: Update the stored previous swing state(s) to the current values so future toggles can be interpreted relative to the latest positions.
requirements: Intended to be called after changing swing settings or receiving a status to synchronize previous/current.

functions.name: IRLgAc::getRaw
functions.description: Return the current 32-bit raw LG A/C code reflecting the stored state.
requirements: If you plan to transmit the raw value externally, ensure checksum and signature are valid (use calcChecksum/validChecksum).

functions.name: IRLgAc::setRaw
functions.signature: void IRLgAc::setRaw(const uint32_t new_code, const decode_type_t protocol = decode_type_t::UNKNOWN)
functions.description: Replace the internal state with a provided 32-bit raw LG A/C code and remember the protocol variant. Useful when importing a decoded IR frame to resend or analyze.
requirements: new_code should be a valid LG A/C raw code that matches the expected format (correct kLgAcSignature and checksum) for reliable operation.
protocol should identify the specific decode_type_t; use decode_type_t::UNKNOWN if not known.
After setting raw, callers may wish to validate via isValidLgAc() or validChecksum().

functions.name: IRLgAc::convertMode
functions.description: Convert a common AC operation mode (stdAc::opmode_t) to the corresponding LG mode code (uint8_t).
requirements: mode must be a valid stdAc::opmode_t value. Unmapped values may convert to a default or model-specific code.

functions.name: IRLgAc::toCommonMode
functions.description: Map an LG mode code (uint8_t) to the common standardized mode value (stdAc::opmode_t).
requirements: mode should be one of LG mode codes defined for this protocol.

functions.name: IRLgAc::toCommonFanSpeed
functions.description: Convert an LG fan speed code (uint8_t) to the corresponding common standardized fan speed (stdAc::fanspeed_t).
requirements: speed should be a valid LG fan code recognized by this implementation.

functions.name: IRLgAc::toCommonSwingV
functions.description: Convert an LG vertical swing raw command/position code to the standardized vertical swing enumeration (stdAc::swingv_t).
requirements: code should be one of the LG SwingV codes supported by this library.

functions.name: IRLgAc::toCommonVaneSwingV
functions.description: Convert an LG per-vane vertical position code to the standardized vertical swing enumeration (stdAc::swingv_t).
requirements: pos should be one of the per-vane position codes (kLgAcVaneSwingVHighest(1) .. kLgAcVaneSwingVLowest(6)).

functions.name: IRLgAc::convertFan
functions.description: Convert a standardized fan speed (stdAc::fanspeed_t) to the corresponding LG fan speed code (uint8_t).
requirements: speed must be a valid stdAc::fanspeed_t value.

functions.name: IRLgAc::convertSwingV
functions.description: Convert a standardized vertical swing setting (stdAc::swingv_t) to the corresponding LG SwingV command/position code.
requirements: swingv must be a valid stdAc::swingv_t value that maps to supported LG SwingV options.

functions.name: IRLgAc::convertVaneSwingV
functions.description: Convert a standardized vertical swing setting (stdAc::swingv_t) to the corresponding per-vane LG SwingV position code (uint8_t).
requirements: swingv must be a valid stdAc::swingv_t value.

functions.name: IRLgAc::toCommon
functions.description: Translate the current internal LG A/C state into the standardized AC state representation (stdAc::state_t). Optionally use a previous state as context for fields not explicitly represented.
requirements: prev may be NULL or point to a valid previous stdAc::state_t.
Returned structure reflects the current stored LG settings mapped to common fields.

functions.name: IRLgAc::toString
functions.description: Produce a human-readable summary of the current LG A/C state for logging/debugging.
requirements: Requires Arduino String support.

functions.name: IRLgAc::setModel
functions.description: Select the target LG remote model profile, affecting encoding/commands (e.g., swing codes, light behavior).
requirements: model must be a valid lg_ac_remote_model_t supported by this library.
Changing the model may alter interpretation/validity of current raw state.

functions.name: IRLgAc::getModel
functions.description: Return the currently selected LG remote model profile.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::IRMideaAC
functions.signature: IRMideaAC::IRMideaAC(const uint16_t pin, const bool inverted = false, const bool use_modulation = true)
functions.description: Constructor for an IRMideaAC controller wrapping an IR transmitter for Midea A/C IR protocol. Creates an internal IRsend/IRsendTest and initializes internal state; actual hardware setup should be done via begin().
requirements: pin must be a valid GPIO capable of driving the IR LED via IRsend on the target platform.
If inverted is true, the IR output logic is inverted (hardware dependent).
If use_modulation is true, carrier modulation (typically 38 kHz) will be used by the IR sender.
Call begin() before calling send().

functions.name: IRMideaAC::stateReset
functions.description: Reset the internal protocol state to defaults for a Midea A/C message. Intended to reinitialize the message fields before further configuration.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::send
functions.description: Transmit the current Midea IR message using the underlying IR transmitter. repeat controls the number of message repetitions.
requirements: Only available when SEND_MIDEA is defined at compile time.
begin() should be called prior to send() so the IR transmitter is configured.
repeat must be a non-negative repeat count appropriate for the protocol (library constant kMideaMinRepeat is the default).
Requires IR sending hardware connected to the specified pin.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::calibrate
functions.description: Run the IR transmitter calibration to compute microsecond timing offsets per modulation for the platform. Returns the per-modulation timing offset as provided by IRsend::calibrate(). This produces a ~65 ms 38 kHz IR burst.
requirements: Only available when SEND_MIDEA is defined at compile time.
Emits a 65 ms IR signal during calibration; ensure it is acceptable to transmit during this call.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::begin
functions.description: Initialize/configure the underlying IR transmitter for subsequent sends. Call once after constructing the object and before send().
requirements: Should be called before any call to send().

functions.name: IRMideaAC::on
functions.description: Convenience to set the power state in the message to on.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::off
functions.description: Convenience to set the power state in the message to off.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setPower
functions.description: Set the message's power bit on or off.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getPower
functions.description: Get the current power bit from the composed message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getUseCelsius
functions.description: Return true if the message is currently configured to use Celsius for temperature fields; false indicates Fahrenheit.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setUseCelsius
functions.description: Configure whether subsequent temperature operations interpret values as Celsius (true) or Fahrenheit (false).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setTemp
functions.signature: void IRMideaAC::setTemp(const uint8_t temp, const bool useCelsius = false)
functions.description: Set the target temperature in the message. useCelsius overrides the global unit flag for this call when true/false as specified.
requirements: If using Celsius, temp should be within the protocol limits: kMideaACMinTempC (17) to kMideaACMaxTempC (30).
If using Fahrenheit, temp should be within kMideaACMinTempF (62) to kMideaACMaxTempF (86).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getTemp
functions.signature: uint8_t IRMideaAC::getTemp(const bool useCelsius = false) const
functions.description: Get the current target temperature from the message in the requested units. If useCelsius is specified, conversion may occur according to internal unit settings.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setSensorTemp
functions.signature: void IRMideaAC::setSensorTemp(const uint8_t temp, const bool useCelsius = false)
functions.description: Set the Follow Me/ambient sensor temperature field or on-timer value, depending on message Type. When used as a temperature, sets the sensed temperature that some remotes send to the A/C.
requirements: If used as a temperature in Celsius, temp should be within kMideaACMinSensorTempC (0) to kMideaACMaxSensorTempC (37).
If used as a temperature in Fahrenheit, temp should be within kMideaACMinSensorTempF (32) to kMideaACMaxSensorTempF (99) (upper bound is a documented guess).
Behavior depends on the current message Type (Normal/Special/FollowMe). Details of when the field is interpreted as timer vs temperature are not fully documented in this header.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getSensorTemp
functions.signature: uint8_t IRMideaAC::getSensorTemp(const bool useCelsius = false) const
functions.description: Get the current sensor temperature (or raw field) in the requested units, depending on message Type. When the field is used for On Timer, the returned value is not defined as a temperature.
requirements: Returned interpretation depends on the message Type; may represent an On Timer value rather than temperature.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setEnableSensorTemp
functions.description: Enable or disable sending the external sensor temperature (Follow Me). Controls the disableSensor bit in the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getEnableSensorTemp
functions.description: Return whether the external sensor temperature (Follow Me) is enabled in the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setFan
functions.description: Set the fan speed in the message. Uses 2-bit values (0..3) corresponding to Auto/Low/Med/High as per constants.
requirements: fan should be one of the defined values: kMideaACFanAuto (0), kMideaACFanLow (1), kMideaACFanMed (2), or kMideaACFanHigh (3).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getFan
functions.description: Get the current fan setting from the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setMode
functions.description: Set the operating mode in the message.
requirements: mode should be one of the defined values: kMideaACCool (0), kMideaACDry (1), kMideaACAuto (2), kMideaACHeat (3), or kMideaACFan (4).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getMode
functions.description: Get the current operating mode from the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setRaw
functions.description: Replace the internal message state with a raw native 64-bit value (lower 48 bits used).
requirements: newState should conform to the Midea protocol structure (48-bit payload) expected by this class.
If not recomputing internally, the checksum should be valid for the given state; otherwise behavior is undefined. Details of automatic checksum handling are not stated here.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getRaw
functions.description: Return the current raw native state as a 64-bit value (only lower 48 bits are meaningful).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::validChecksum
functions.description: Validate the checksum of a provided raw Midea protocol state.
requirements: state must be a 48-bit Midea message packed into a 64-bit integer as per this header's MideaProtocol union.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setSleep
functions.description: Set the Sleep feature bit in the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getSleep
functions.description: Get the current Sleep bit from the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::isSwingVToggle
functions.description: Return true if the current message is configured as a Vertical Swing toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setSwingVToggle
functions.description: Enable or disable composing a Vertical Swing toggle special command in the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getSwingVToggle
functions.description: Get whether the message is set to send a Vertical Swing toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::isSwingVStep
functions.description: Return true if the message is configured to send a Vertical Swing step command (Kaysun-specific variant).
requirements: Only available when KAYSUN_AC is defined at compile time.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setSwingVStep
functions.description: Enable or disable composing a Vertical Swing step command (Kaysun-specific variant).
requirements: Only available when KAYSUN_AC is defined at compile time.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getSwingVStep
functions.description: Get whether the message is set to send a Vertical Swing step command (Kaysun-specific variant).
requirements: Only available when KAYSUN_AC is defined at compile time.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::isEconoToggle
functions.description: Return true if the message is configured as an Economy (Econo) mode toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setEconoToggle
functions.description: Enable or disable composing an Economy (Econo) mode toggle special command in the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getEconoToggle
functions.description: Get whether the message is set to send an Econo toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::isTurboToggle
functions.description: Return true if the message is configured as a Turbo mode toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setTurboToggle
functions.description: Enable or disable composing a Turbo mode toggle special command in the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getTurboToggle
functions.description: Get whether the message is set to send a Turbo toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::isLightToggle
functions.description: Return true if the message is configured as a Display/Light toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setLightToggle
functions.description: Enable or disable composing a Display/Light toggle special command in the message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getLightToggle
functions.description: Get whether the message is set to send a Display/Light toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::isCleanToggle
functions.description: Return true if the message is configured as a Self-Clean toggle special command (only valid in Auto/Cool/Dry modes per comment).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setCleanToggle
functions.description: Enable or disable composing a Self-Clean toggle special command.
requirements: Self-Clean toggle is only valid when Mode is Auto, Cool, or Dry (per header constants/comments).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getCleanToggle
functions.description: Get whether the message is set to send a Self-Clean toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::is8CHeatToggle
functions.description: Return true if the message is configured as an 8°C Heat (Freeze Protection) toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::set8CHeatToggle
functions.description: Enable or disable composing an 8°C Heat (Freeze Protection) toggle special command.
requirements: Per comment, 8°C Heat is only available/valid in Heat mode.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::get8CHeatToggle
functions.description: Get whether the message is set to send an 8°C Heat toggle special command.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::isQuiet
functions.description: Return true if Quiet mode is currently active in the composed state.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setQuiet
functions.description: Enable or disable Quiet mode. Uses internal state to compose either the Quiet On or Quiet Off command as needed.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getQuiet
functions.description: Get whether Quiet mode is set in the current message.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getType
functions.description: Get the current message Type field (Normal/Command, Special, or Follow Me), encoded in 3 bits.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::isOnTimerEnabled
functions.description: Return true if the On Timer is enabled in the current message. The On Timer is encoded in the SensorTemp byte when Type indicates OnTimer.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getOnTimer
functions.description: Get the On Timer value in minutes if enabled. The timer is stored as a count of half-hours in the SensorTemp byte (masked by 0b01111110).
requirements: Interpretation is in half-hour units; actual minute value equals halfHours*30. Maximum value is limited by 7-bit masked storage (see header comment).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setOnTimer
functions.description: Set the On Timer in minutes. Internally stored as a number of half-hours in the SensorTemp byte, when the message Type indicates OnTimer.
requirements: mins should be a multiple of 30 minutes because the protocol stores half-hour units.

The representable range is limited by 7-bit masked storage (0..63 half-hours, i.e., 0..1890 minutes). Exact disable semantics are not documented here; how to clear/disable the On Timer is unspecified in this header.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::isOffTimerEnabled
functions.description: Return true if the Off Timer is enabled in the current message. Off is encoded as 0b111111 (kMideaACTimerOff) in the OffTimer field.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::getOffTimer
functions.description: Get the Off Timer value in minutes if enabled. The OffTimer field encodes the number of half-hours; the special value 0b111111 means timer off/disabled.
requirements: Interpretation is in half-hour units; actual minute value equals halfHours*30.
Maximum encodable value is 6-bit (0..63 half-hours), but 0b111111 is reserved for Off.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::setOffTimer
functions.description: Set the Off Timer in minutes. Internally stored as a 6-bit number of half-hours in the OffTimer field; 0b111111 represents 'off/disabled'.
requirements: mins should be a multiple of 30 minutes because the protocol stores half-hour units.
The representable enabled range is 0..62 half-hours (0..1860 minutes). The value 63 (0b111111) is reserved to indicate the timer is off/disabled.
Exact API semantics to disable (e.g., passing a special value) are not stated; only the underlying encoding is documented.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::convertMode
functions.description: Convert a common HVAC operation mode (stdAc::opmode_t) to the Midea mode nibble used by this class.
requirements: mode must be a valid stdAc::opmode_t value.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::convertFan
functions.description: Convert a common HVAC fan speed (stdAc::fanspeed_t) to the Midea fan code used by this class.
requirements: speed must be a valid stdAc::fanspeed_t value.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::toCommonMode
functions.description: Map a Midea mode code to the common stdAc::opmode_t enumeration.
requirements: mode should be one of the Midea-defined mode codes (0..4).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::toCommonFanSpeed
functions.description: Map a Midea fan speed code to the common stdAc::fanspeed_t enumeration.
requirements: speed should be one of the Midea-defined fan codes (0..3).

functions.name: IRMideaAC::toCommon
functions.description: Translate the current internal state into the library's common A/C state representation (stdAc::state_t). Optionally uses a previous state as a baseline.
requirements: prev, if supplied, must point to a valid stdAc::state_t instance or be NULL.

functions.name: IRMideaAC::toString
functions.description: Return a human-readable summary of the current internal state as an Arduino String.
requirements: Requires Arduino String support (Arduino.h) when compiling in Arduino environments.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::IRMirageAc
functions.signature: IRMirageAc::IRMirageAc(const uint16_t pin, const bool inverted = false, const bool use_modulation = true)
functions.description: Constructs a controller for Mirage 120-bit A/C IR messages, binding it to a hardware transmit pin and configuring IR carrier modulation parameters. Typical usage: create an instance once, then call begin(), set state (mode, temp, etc.), and send() when available.
requirements: pin must be a valid GPIO capable of driving an IR LED via IRsend on the target platform (Arduino/ESP).
inverted selects active-low drive if true; use_modulation controls 38 kHz modulation usage.
Object should be instantiated before any calls to its methods.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::stateReset
functions.description: Resets the internal Mirage protocol state buffer to library defaults for a known-safe starting configuration.
requirements: May alter all previously set options; caller should re-apply desired settings after reset before sending.
Should be called before first use if you want a known default state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::send
functions.description: Transmits the currently configured Mirage 120-bit IR message, optionally repeating it multiple times.
requirements: Only available when compiled with SEND_MIRAGE enabled.
begin() should be called before send() to initialize the IR transmitter.
repeat controls how many times the frame is emitted; must fit in uint16_t.
Internal state should be valid (e.g., checksum consistent) before sending.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::calibrate
functions.description: Runs IR carrier timing calibration and returns the microsecond modulation timing offset per carrier cycle. Produces a ~65 ms 38 kHz IR burst. Typically called once after construction if needed.
requirements: Only available when compiled with SEND_MIRAGE enabled (method forwards to IRsend::calibrate()).
Emits a visible IR burst; should not be called while controlling real equipment unless acceptable.
Return value is an offset in microseconds per modulation cycle; caller may ignore or log it.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::begin
functions.description: Initializes the underlying IR transmitter and prepares the object for use.
requirements: Call before send() or any operation that requires initialized IR hardware.
Safe to call once per instance before first transmission.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::on
functions.description: Convenience method to set the internal power state to ON.
requirements: Affects only internal state until send() is called (when SEND_MIRAGE is available).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::off
functions.description: Convenience method to set the internal power state to OFF.
requirements: Affects only internal state until send() is called (when SEND_MIRAGE is available).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setPower
functions.description: Sets the internal power state flag to ON or OFF for the next transmission.
requirements: Pass true to turn on, false to turn off.
Does not transmit by itself; combine with send() to apply to the A/C.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getPower
functions.description: Returns the current internal power state flag.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setTemp
functions.description: Sets the target temperature in Celsius in the internal state, mapped to the Mirage encoding (Temp byte = degrees - 0x5C).
requirements: degrees must be within the supported Mirage range: 16..32 Celsius (kMirageAcMinTemp..kMirageAcMaxTemp).
Values outside the supported range are not defined by the header and may be clamped or ignored by the implementation.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getTemp
functions.description: Gets the target temperature in Celsius from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setFan
functions.description: Sets the fan speed in the internal state according to the Mirage protocol's fan codes. Uses different code ordering for some remotes (e.g., KKG29A-C1).
requirements: speed must be one of the defined Mirage fan codes for the current model: for general Mirage (kMirageAcFanAuto, kMirageAcFanHigh, kMirageAcFanMed, kMirageAcFanLow) or for KKG29A-C1 (kMirageAcKKG29AC1FanAuto, kMirageAcKKG29AC1FanHigh, kMirageAcKKG29AC1FanLow, kMirageAcKKG29AC1FanMed).
Call setModel() appropriately so speed is interpreted for the correct remote model.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getFan
functions.description: Returns the raw Mirage fan speed code currently set in the internal state.
requirements: Returned code is a protocol value; use toCommonFanSpeed() to map to a common enum if needed.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setMode
functions.description: Sets the operating mode (Cool/Heat/Dry/Fan/Recycle) in the internal state using the Mirage protocol codes.
requirements: mode must be one of the Mirage mode codes: kMirageAcHeat, kMirageAcCool, kMirageAcDry, kMirageAcRecycle, or kMirageAcFan.
Some features (e.g., Turbo) may only be valid in certain modes as noted in bitfield comments (e.g., Turbo works only in Cool).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getMode
functions.description: Gets the current operating mode as a Mirage protocol mode code.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getRaw
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal 120-bit (kMirageStateLength bytes) Mirage state buffer for direct inspection or modification.
requirements: Pointer refers to an internal buffer of size kMirageStateLength; do not read or write beyond that size.
Modifying the buffer affects subsequent operations; caller should maintain checksum correctness (see checksum-related helpers).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setRaw
functions.description: Overwrites the internal state with the provided raw Mirage state bytes.
requirements: data must be a valid, non-null pointer to a buffer of length kMirageStateLength bytes.
Caller is responsible for ensuring the provided state is well-formed, including a correct checksum.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getClock
functions.description: Returns the current clock value from the internal state as a total number of seconds as represented by the protocol fields.
requirements: Exact epoch/semantics are protocol-specific; this header does not define the origin. Values are stored across Hours/Minutes/Seconds BCD fields for some models.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setClock
functions.description: Sets the internal clock value from a total number of seconds, mapping into the protocol’s time fields (Hours/Minutes/Seconds, often BCD-encoded for certain remotes).
requirements: nr_of_seconds must fit within the protocol’s time field capacities; exact bounds are not fully specified in the header.
Time fields for KKG9A-C1 are BCD-encoded seconds/minutes/hours; caller should pass a sensible value.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setTurbo
functions.description: Sets the Turbo mode flag in the internal state.
requirements: Based on comments, Turbo only works in Cool mode on some remotes; ensure mode compatibility.
Affects only internal state until transmitted.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getTurbo
functions.description: Returns whether Turbo mode is enabled in the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setLight
functions.description: Sets the Display/Light feature flag in the internal state (name varies by remote).
requirements: Effect and availability may depend on remote model (e.g., Light_Kkg9ac1, LightToggle_Kkg29ac1).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getLight
functions.description: Returns whether the Display/Light feature is currently enabled in the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setSleep
functions.description: Enables or disables Sleep mode in the internal state.
requirements: Sleep feature presence is model-specific (Sleep_Kkg9ac1, Sleep_Kkg29ac1).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getSleep
functions.description: Returns whether Sleep mode is enabled in the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setSwingV
functions.description: Sets the vertical swing position or mode in the internal state using Mirage swing codes.
requirements: position must be one of the defined vertical swing codes: kMirageAcSwingVOff, kMirageAcSwingVLowest, kMirageAcSwingVLow, kMirageAcSwingVMiddle, kMirageAcSwingVHigh, kMirageAcSwingVHighest, or kMirageAcSwingVAuto.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getSwingV
functions.description: Returns the raw vertical swing code from the internal state.
requirements: Returned code is protocol-specific; use toCommonSwingV() to map to a common enum if needed.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setSwingH
functions.description: Enables or disables horizontal swing in the internal state (when supported by the model).
requirements: Horizontal swing presence is model-specific (e.g., KKG29A-C1 has SwingH flag).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getSwingH
functions.description: Returns whether horizontal swing is enabled in the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setQuiet
functions.description: Sets the Quiet/Silent mode flag in the internal state (where supported).
requirements: Quiet feature availability appears in the KKG29A-C1 mapping; ensure model supports it.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getQuiet
functions.description: Returns whether Quiet/Silent mode is enabled in the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setCleanToggle
functions.description: Sets the Clean function toggle flag in the internal state (where supported).
requirements: Clean toggle availability indicated for KKG29A-C1; ensure model supports it.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getCleanToggle
functions.description: Returns whether the Clean function toggle is enabled in the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setFilter
functions.description: Sets the Filter/UVC feature flag in the internal state (where supported).
requirements: Feature is labeled Filter (aka UVC) for KKG29A-C1; ensure model supports it.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getFilter
functions.description: Returns whether the Filter/UVC feature is enabled in the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setIFeel
functions.description: Enables or disables the IFeel (remote sensor) feature flag in the internal state.
requirements: IFeel feature availability indicated for KKG29A-C1; ensure model supports it.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getIFeel
functions.description: Returns whether the IFeel feature is enabled in the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setSensorTemp
functions.description: Sets the remote sensor temperature in Celsius for IFeel, encoded per protocol (with an offset applied internally).
requirements: degrees should be within the supported sensor temperature range 0..43C (kMirageAcSensorTempMax); protocol uses an offset of 20 (kMirageAcSensorTempOffset).
Feature is meaningful only if IFeel is supported/enabled.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getSensorTemp
functions.description: Returns the sensor temperature in Celsius from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getOnTimer
functions.description: Returns the current On Timer setting as total minutes from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getOffTimer
functions.description: Returns the current Off Timer setting as total minutes from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setOnTimer
functions.description: Sets the On Timer in total minutes, mapped to protocol hours/minutes fields (OnTimerHours/OnTimerMins).
requirements: nr_of_mins must be representable by the protocol fields: hours (5 bits, 0..31) and minutes (6 bits, 0..59), i.e., 0..(31*60+59) minutes.
Feature availability may depend on model (e.g., KKG29A-C1).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setOffTimer
functions.description: Sets the Off Timer in total minutes, mapped to protocol hours/minutes fields (OffTimerHours/OffTimerMins).
requirements: nr_of_mins must be representable by the protocol fields: hours (5 bits, 0..31) and minutes (6 bits, 0..59), i.e., 0..(31*60+59) minutes.
Feature availability may depend on model (e.g., KKG29A-C1).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getModel
functions.signature: mirage_ac_remote_model_t IRMirageAc::getModel(const bool useRaw = false) const
functions.description: Returns the current remote model that the instance is configured to emulate. When useRaw is true, it may attempt to infer the model from the raw state.
requirements: useRaw=false returns the configured model stored in the object; useRaw=true may derive from current raw state if supported.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::getModel
functions.description: Static helper that determines the Mirage remote model by inspecting a provided raw state buffer.
requirements: state must be a valid, non-null pointer to a buffer of length kMirageStateLength bytes.
Buffer contents should represent a Mirage 120-bit message.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::setModel
functions.description: Sets the current remote model variant, affecting encoding of certain fields (e.g., fan code ordering, feature availability).
requirements: model must be a valid mirage_ac_remote_model_t value supported by this library.
Changing the model may reinterpret some existing internal state fields; caller should review and update state accordingly.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::validChecksum
functions.description: Verifies whether the provided raw Mirage state buffer’s checksum is valid according to the protocol (sum of prior nibbles).
requirements: data must be a valid, non-null pointer to a buffer of length kMirageStateLength bytes.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::calculateChecksum
functions.description: Computes the Mirage protocol checksum byte for the provided raw state buffer.
requirements: data must be a valid, non-null pointer to a buffer of length kMirageStateLength bytes.
Caller should write the returned checksum into the appropriate checksum field of the message when constructing raw packets.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::convertMode
functions.description: Converts a common A/C operating mode (stdAc::opmode_t) to the corresponding Mirage protocol mode code.
requirements: mode must be a valid stdAc::opmode_t value.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::convertFan
functions.signature: static uint8_t IRMirageAc::convertFan(const stdAc::fanspeed_t speed, const mirage_ac_remote_model_t model = mirage_ac_remote_model_t::KKG9AC1)
functions.description: Converts a common fan speed (stdAc::fanspeed_t) to a Mirage protocol fan code, honoring model-specific mappings.
requirements: speed must be a valid stdAc::fanspeed_t value.
model selects which fan code mapping to use (e.g., KKG9AC1 vs KKG29A-C1).

functions.name: IRMirageAc::convertSwingV
functions.description: Converts a common vertical swing position enum to a Mirage protocol swing code.
requirements: position must be a valid stdAc::swingv_t value.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::toCommonMode
functions.description: Maps a Mirage protocol mode code to the common stdAc::opmode_t value.
requirements: mode must be a valid Mirage mode code.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::toCommonFanSpeed
functions.signature: static stdAc::fanspeed_t IRMirageAc::toCommonFanSpeed(const uint8_t speed, const mirage_ac_remote_model_t model = mirage_ac_remote_model_t::KKG9AC1)
functions.description: Maps a Mirage protocol fan code to the common stdAc::fanspeed_t value, using the specified model’s mapping.
requirements: speed must be a valid Mirage fan code for the given model.
model must be a valid mirage_ac_remote_model_t.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::toCommonSwingV
functions.description: Converts a Mirage vertical swing code to the common stdAc::swingv_t value.
requirements: pos must be a valid Mirage vertical swing code.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::toCommon
functions.description: Translates the current internal Mirage state to the library’s common A/C state representation (stdAc::state_t).
requirements: Resulting state is a snapshot of internal fields mapped to common enums and values.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::fromCommon
functions.description: Configures the internal Mirage state from a common A/C state (stdAc::state_t), converting modes, fan, swing, temperature, timers, etc.
requirements: state must contain valid enum values; unsupported fields for a given model may be ignored or approximated by the implementation.

functions.name: IRMirageAc::toString
functions.description: Returns a human-readable summary of the current internal Mirage state for debugging/logging.
requirements: Requires Arduino String support (not available in some UNIT_TEST configurations unless provided).

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::IRMitsubishiAC
functions.signature: explicit IRMitsubishiAC::IRMitsubishiAC(const uint16_t pin, const bool inverted = false, const bool use_modulation = true)
functions.description: Constructs an IRMitsubishiAC controller bound to a specific IR output pin. Optional flags control signal inversion and whether to use IR carrier modulation. Typically followed by begin() to initialize the sender, then setters and send().
requirements: pin must be a valid GPIO capable of driving the IR transmitter on the target platform
begin() should be called before attempting to send IR frames
If inverted is true, the output logic is inverted
If use_modulation is false, the IR is sent without carrier modulation (hardware must support it)

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::stateReset
functions.description: Resets the internal 144-bit Mitsubishi A/C state to library defaults. Use this to reinitialize the message state prior to making new configuration changes.
requirements: Call begin() before sending after a reset if hardware needs initialization
Existing customizations in the state are lost after reset

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::validChecksum
functions.description: Validates the checksum of a raw Mitsubishi 144-bit A/C state buffer. Returns true if checksum matches expected value.
requirements: data must point to a buffer of length kMitsubishiACStateLength bytes
data must be non-null

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::send
functions.description: Transmits the currently configured Mitsubishi 144-bit A/C IR message, repeating it the specified number of times.
requirements: Requires the library to be compiled with SEND_MITSUBISHI_AC enabled
begin() must have been called successfully before sending
repeat must be a valid count; typical minimum is kMitsubishiACMinRepeat
An IR LED and driver circuit must be connected to the configured pin

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::calibrate
functions.description: Runs the IR sender calibration to determine microsecond timing offset per modulation for this platform. Emits about a 65ms 38kHz IR pulse. Returns the computed timing offset.
requirements: Requires SEND_MITSUBISHI_AC to be enabled
May produce a visible IR transmission during calibration
Should be called once per object instantiation at most

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::begin
functions.description: Initializes the underlying IR sender for the IRMitsubishiAC instance. Call before sending commands.
requirements: Must be called after constructing the object and before calling send() or calibrate()
The configured pin must be available for output

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::on
functions.description: Sets the internal state to power on for the Mitsubishi A/C message.
requirements: Has effect on the next send()
Device must be later controlled by calling send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::off
functions.description: Sets the internal state to power off for the Mitsubishi A/C message.
requirements: Has effect on the next send()
Device must be later controlled by calling send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setPower
functions.description: Sets the power state (on/off) in the internal Mitsubishi A/C message.
requirements: Set on to true for power on, false for power off
Call send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getPower
functions.description: Returns the currently configured power state from the internal message.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setTemp
functions.description: Sets the target temperature in degrees Celsius in the internal state for Mitsubishi 144-bit protocol.
requirements: degrees should be within kMitsubishiAcMinTemp (16.0) to kMitsubishiAcMaxTemp (31.0)
Some models support half-degree increments via HalfDegree bit; otherwise whole degrees
Call send() to apply to the device

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getTemp
functions.description: Gets the currently configured target temperature in degrees Celsius from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setFan
functions.description: Sets the fan speed in the internal Mitsubishi 144-bit message.
requirements: Allowed values are typically kMitsubishiAcFanAuto (0), 1..kMitsubishiAcFanRealMax (4), kMitsubishiAcFanMax (5), and kMitsubishiAcFanSilent (6) as supported by the target unit
Call send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getFan
functions.description: Returns the currently configured fan speed from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setMode
functions.description: Sets the operating mode (e.g., Auto/Cool/Dry/Heat/Fan) in the internal state for Mitsubishi 144-bit protocol.
requirements: mode should be one of kMitsubishiAcAuto (0b100), kMitsubishiAcCool (0b011), kMitsubishiAcDry (0b010), kMitsubishiAcHeat (0b001), or kMitsubishiAcFan (0b111)
Call send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getMode
functions.description: Gets the currently configured operating mode from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setISave10C
functions.description: Enables or disables the i-SAVE 10°C feature bit in the internal state (specific to Heat mode with i-SAVE and 10°C on remote).
requirements: Feature availability depends on model; setting only changes the internal state
Call send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getISave10C
functions.description: Returns the current i-SAVE 10°C bit state from the internal message.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setISee
functions.description: Enables or disables the I-See (occupancy/IR sensor) feature bit in the Mitsubishi 144-bit message.
requirements: Availability depends on model; this sets only the message bit
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getISee
functions.description: Gets the I-See feature bit from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setDirectIndirect
functions.description: Sets the Direct/Indirect airflow mode in the internal message.
requirements: position should be one of kMitsubishiAcDirectOff (0b00), kMitsubishiAcIndirect (0b01), or kMitsubishiAcDirect (0b11)
Call send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getDirectIndirect
functions.description: Returns the currently configured Direct/Indirect airflow setting.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setEcocool
functions.description: Enables or disables the Eco-cool feature bit in the internal state.
requirements: Availability depends on model; this sets only the message bit
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getEcocool
functions.description: Gets the Eco-cool feature bit from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setAbsenseDetect
functions.description: Enables or disables the Absence Detect feature bit in the internal Mitsubishi 144-bit message.
requirements: Feature availability depends on model; this toggles only the message bit
Call send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getAbsenseDetect
functions.description: Returns the Absence Detect feature bit from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setNaturalFlow
functions.description: Enables or disables Natural Flow feature in the internal Mitsubishi 144-bit message.
requirements: Feature availability depends on model; this toggles only the message bit
Call send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getNaturalFlow
functions.description: Gets the Natural Flow feature bit from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setVane
functions.description: Sets the vertical vane position (or right vane on some models) in the internal state.
requirements: position should be one of the vertical vane constants: kMitsubishiAcVaneAuto, kMitsubishiAcVaneHighest, kMitsubishiAcVaneHigh, kMitsubishiAcVaneMiddle, kMitsubishiAcVaneLow, kMitsubishiAcVaneLowest, or kMitsubishiAcVaneSwing
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getVane
functions.description: Returns the current vertical/right vane setting from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setVaneLeft
functions.description: Sets the left vertical vane position (on models that support separate left/right) in the internal state.
requirements: position is a 3-bit value; valid positions mirror vertical vane constants for left vane
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getVaneLeft
functions.description: Returns the current left vane position from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setWideVane
functions.description: Sets the horizontal wide vane position (swing H) in the internal state.
requirements: position should be one of kMitsubishiAcWideVaneLeftMax, kMitsubishiAcWideVaneLeft, kMitsubishiAcWideVaneMiddle, kMitsubishiAcWideVaneRight, kMitsubishiAcWideVaneRightMax, kMitsubishiAcWideVaneWide, or kMitsubishiAcWideVaneAuto
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getWideVane
functions.description: Returns the current horizontal wide vane setting from the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getRaw
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal 144-bit raw state buffer for direct access.
requirements: Returned pointer is owned by the object; do not free it
Buffer size is kMitsubishiACStateLength bytes
Modifying the buffer directly may require recalculating checksum via internal methods before send()

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setRaw
functions.description: Replaces the internal 144-bit state with the provided raw buffer.
requirements: data must be non-null and point to kMitsubishiACStateLength bytes
For safety, data should have a valid checksum (see validChecksum)
Caller is responsible for ensuring values are valid for the target device

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getClock
functions.description: Gets the clock field from the 144-bit state (encoding is device-specific).
requirements: Clock encoding/range is not specified in this header; interpretation is unknown

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setClock
functions.description: Sets the clock field in the 144-bit state. Exact encoding is device-specific.
requirements: clock is an 8-bit value; exact valid range/encoding unknown from this header
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getStartClock
functions.description: Gets the Start Clock (timer start) field from the internal state.
requirements: Exact encoding/range is not specified in this header; interpretation unknown

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setStartClock
functions.description: Sets the Start Clock (timer start) field in the internal state.
requirements: clock is an 8-bit value; exact valid range/encoding unknown from this header
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getStopClock
functions.description: Gets the Stop Clock (timer stop) field from the internal state.
requirements: Exact encoding/range is not specified in this header; interpretation unknown

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setStopClock
functions.description: Sets the Stop Clock (timer stop) field in the internal state.
requirements: clock is an 8-bit value; exact valid range/encoding unknown from this header
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getTimer
functions.description: Gets the timer mode field from the internal state (e.g., none/start/stop/start+stop).
requirements: Interpretation uses constants: kMitsubishiAcNoTimer, kMitsubishiAcStartTimer, kMitsubishiAcStopTimer, kMitsubishiAcStartStopTimer

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setTimer
functions.description: Sets the timer mode in the internal state (none/start/stop/start+stop).
requirements: timer should be one of kMitsubishiAcNoTimer, kMitsubishiAcStartTimer, kMitsubishiAcStopTimer, or kMitsubishiAcStartStopTimer
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::getWeeklyTimerEnabled
functions.description: Returns whether the weekly timer bit is enabled in the internal state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::setWeeklyTimerEnabled
functions.description: Enables or disables the weekly timer bit in the internal state.
requirements: Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::convertMode
functions.description: Converts a common stdAc operating mode to a Mitsubishi 144-bit mode value.
requirements: mode must be a valid stdAc::opmode_t
Returned value should be used with setMode()

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::convertFan
functions.description: Converts a common stdAc fan speed to a Mitsubishi 144-bit fan value.
requirements: speed must be a valid stdAc::fanspeed_t
Returned value should be used with setFan()

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::convertSwingV
functions.description: Converts a common stdAc vertical swing position to a Mitsubishi 144-bit vertical vane value.
requirements: position must be a valid stdAc::swingv_t

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::convertSwingH
functions.description: Converts a common stdAc horizontal swing position to a Mitsubishi 144-bit wide vane value.
requirements: position must be a valid stdAc::swingh_t

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::toCommonMode
functions.description: Maps a Mitsubishi 144-bit mode value to the common stdAc operating mode enum.
requirements: mode should be one of the kMitsubishiAc* mode constants; other values may map to a default/unknown

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::toCommonFanSpeed
functions.description: Maps a Mitsubishi 144-bit fan value to the common stdAc fan speed enum.
requirements: speed should be a valid fan value as per kMitsubishiAcFan* constants

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::toCommonSwingV
functions.description: Maps a Mitsubishi 144-bit vertical vane value to the common stdAc vertical swing enum.
requirements: pos should be one of the kMitsubishiAcVane* constants

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::toCommonSwingH
functions.description: Maps a Mitsubishi 144-bit wide vane value to the common stdAc horizontal swing enum.
requirements: pos should be one of the kMitsubishiAcWideVane* constants

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::toCommon
functions.description: Converts the entire internal Mitsubishi 144-bit state to a common stdAc::state_t structure for interoperability.
requirements: Requires stdAc types to be available via includes used by this library

functions.name: IRMitsubishiAC::toString
functions.description: Returns a human-readable summary of the current internal Mitsubishi 144-bit state.

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::IRMitsubishi136
functions.signature: explicit IRMitsubishi136::IRMitsubishi136(const uint16_t pin, const bool inverted = false, const bool use_modulation = true)
functions.description: Constructs an IRMitsubishi136 controller for Mitsubishi 136-bit protocol, with options for inverted output and carrier modulation.
requirements: pin must be a valid GPIO for IR output
Call begin() before sending

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::stateReset

Call begin() before sending if required by platform

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::send
functions.description: Transmits the currently configured Mitsubishi 136-bit IR message, repeating it as specified.

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::begin

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::validChecksum
functions.signature: static bool IRMitsubishi136::validChecksum(const uint8_t* data, const uint16_t len = kMitsubishi136StateLength)
functions.description: Validates the checksum of a raw Mitsubishi 136-bit A/C buffer of given length. Returns true if valid.
requirements: data must be non-null
len must be the correct state length (typically kMitsubishi136StateLength) for a full frame

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::on

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::off
functions.description: Sets power-off in the internal 136-bit state.
requirements: Call send() to transmit the change

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::setPower
functions.description: Sets the power state flag in the internal 136-bit message.
requirements: Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::getPower
functions.description: Gets the power state flag from the internal 136-bit message.

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::setTemp
functions.description: Sets the target temperature (°C) in the internal 136-bit message.
requirements: degrees should be within kMitsubishi136MinTemp (17) to kMitsubishi136MaxTemp (30)
Call send() to apply

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::getTemp

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::setFan
functions.description: Sets the fan speed in the internal 136-bit state.
requirements: speed should be one of kMitsubishi136FanMin (0b00), kMitsubishi136FanLow (0b01), kMitsubishi136FanMed (0b10), or kMitsubishi136FanMax (0b11)
kMitsubishi136FanQuiet equals Min

functions.name: IRMitsubishi136::getFan

functions.name: IRNeoclimaAc::IRNeoclimaAc
functions.signature: IRNeoclimaAc::IRNeoclimaAc(const uint16_t pin, const bool inverted = false, const bool use_modulation = true)
functions.description: Constructor for a Neoclima A/C IR controller. Initializes an instance bound to a specific output pin, with optional signal inversion and carrier modulation control. Typically followed by begin() before attempting to transmit.
requirements: pin must reference a valid output-capable GPIO for the target platform
inverted selects electrical polarity of the IR output driver; choose according to hardware wiring
use_modulation selects whether to use carrier modulation (typically 38 kHz)
Call begin() before any sending operations (e.g., send(), calibrate())

functions.name: IRNeoclimaAc::stateReset
functions.description: Reset the internal protocol state to a known default for Neoclima messages. Use to initialize or clear settings before customizing fields.

functions.name: IRNeoclimaAc::send
functions.description: Transmit the currently configured Neoclima A/C message via IR. The repeat parameter controls how many times the message is sent back-to-back.
requirements: Only available when SEND_NEOCLIMA is enabled at compile time
begin() must be called successfully before send()
repeat specifies the number of transmissions; must fit within uint16_t
Underlying hardware (IR LED/driver) must be present and connected to the configured pin

functions.name: IRNeoclimaAc::calibrate
functions.description: Calibrate the IR transmitter timing for the current platform and configuration. Returns the timing offset per modulation step. Produces a ~65 ms 38 kHz IR signal during calibration.
requirements: Only available when SEND_NEOCLIMA is enabled at compile time
Should be called at most once per object instantiation if needed
IR emitter hardware must be present; calling emits a visible IR signal

functions.name: IRNeoclimaAc::begin
functions.description: Initialize the underlying IR sender for use (configure pin, timers, and modulation as needed). Must be called before sending.
requirements: Call before send() or calibrate()
Must be called after constructing the object with a valid pin

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::IRPanasonicAc
functions.signature: explicit IRPanasonicAc::IRPanasonicAc(const uint16_t pin, const bool inverted = false, const bool use_modulation = true)
functions.description: Constructor for a Panasonic A/C IR controller bound to a specific transmit pin. Creates an IR sender instance and readies internal state for later configuration and transmission.
requirements: pin must be a valid GPIO/transmit-capable pin for the target platform/IR transmitter hardware.
If inverted is true, hardware output logic should match an active-low IR LED driver; otherwise active-high.
If use_modulation is true, the sender will modulate at the protocol’s carrier (kPanasonicFreq). Hardware must support modulation if enabled.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::stateReset
functions.description: Reset the internal Panasonic A/C message state to a known default. Use to return to a baseline configuration before setting fields like power, temp, mode, etc.
requirements: May clear previously set options; caller should reapply desired settings after calling.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::send
functions.description: Transmit the current Panasonic A/C IR message, repeating as requested. Uses the IRsend backend with Panasonic timings.
requirements: This function is only available when compiled with SEND_PANASONIC_AC defined.
begin() should be called prior to send() to initialize the IR transmitter.
repeat is the number of times the message is sent; must be a non-negative 16-bit value (commonly small).
Hardware must have an IR LED connected to pin passed to the constructor and be capable of driving the carrier frequency (kPanasonicFreq).

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::calibrate
functions.description: Run IR transmitter calibration to determine microsecond timing offset per modulation cycle. Produces a ~65 ms 38 kHz IR burst once per invocation.
requirements: Only available when compiled with SEND_PANASONIC_AC defined.
Should be called at most once per object instantiation, if needed, as per note.
An IR LED will actively transmit during calibration; ensure it is safe to emit.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::begin
functions.description: Initialize the underlying IR transmitter for subsequent Panasonic transmissions. Typically sets up the pin and carrier frequency.
requirements: Call before send() or calibration-dependent operations.
The GPIO pin provided at construction must be available and not used by other peripherals.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::on
functions.description: Set the power state in the internal message to ON. Does not transmit by itself; use send() to emit.
requirements: Internal state must later be transmitted via send() to affect a device.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::off
functions.description: Set the power state in the internal message to OFF. Does not transmit by itself; use send() to emit.
requirements: Internal state must later be transmitted via send() to affect a device.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::setPower
functions.description: Set the power state flag in the internal Panasonic A/C command.
requirements: Pass true to turn on, false to turn off.
Does not transmit; call send() to emit the updated command.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::getPower
functions.description: Get the current power flag from the internal Panasonic A/C message state.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::setTemp
functions.signature: void IRPanasonicAc::setTemp(const uint8_t temp, const bool remember = true)
functions.description: Set the target temperature in the internal Panasonic A/C message. Optionally remember the temperature when changing to/from fan-only mode.
requirements: temp should be within the supported range: kPanasonicAcMinTemp (16 C) to kPanasonicAcMaxTemp (30 C).
In fan-only mode, some models may force kPanasonicAcFanModeTemp (27 C); behavior may depend on remember flag and model.
Does not transmit; call send() to emit.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::getTemp
functions.description: Return the target temperature currently stored in the internal state.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::setFan
functions.description: Set the indoor fan speed in the internal message. Accepts Panasonic fan codes (e.g., kPanasonicAcFanMin/Low/Med/High/Max or kPanasonicAcFanAuto).
requirements: fan should be one of the defined constants: 0..4 for discrete speeds, or kPanasonicAcFanAuto (7).
Does not transmit; call send() to emit.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::getFan
functions.description: Get the current fan speed code from the internal state.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::setMode
functions.description: Set the operating mode (Auto, Dry, Cool, Heat, Fan) in the internal Panasonic message.
requirements: mode should be one of kPanasonicAcAuto, kPanasonicAcDry, kPanasonicAcCool, kPanasonicAcHeat, or kPanasonicAcFan.
Does not transmit; call send() to emit.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::getMode
functions.description: Get the current operating mode code from the internal state.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::setRaw
functions.description: Replace the entire internal raw Panasonic A/C message state from a caller-provided byte array.
requirements: state must point to at least kPanasonicAcStateLength bytes containing a complete Panasonic A/C frame for this implementation.
state must not be null.
Caller should ensure the provided state has a valid checksum (use validChecksum/calcChecksum) or expect the class to fix/compute it if applicable.
Does not transmit; call send() to emit.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::getRaw
functions.description: Access the internal raw state buffer storing the Panasonic A/C message.
requirements: Returns a pointer to an internal buffer of length kPanasonicAcStateLength bytes; lifetime is tied to the IRPanasonicAc instance.
Modifying the returned buffer changes the internal state; caller should ensure checksum consistency (see calcChecksum/fixChecksum if available).

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::validChecksum
functions.signature: static bool IRPanasonicAc::validChecksum(const uint8_t *state, const uint16_t length = kPanasonicAcStateLength)
functions.description: Validate the checksum of a Panasonic A/C state buffer.
requirements: state must point to at least length bytes.
state must not be null.
length should match the expected Panasonic A/C state size (kPanasonicAcStateLength) for typical use.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::calcChecksum
functions.signature: static uint8_t IRPanasonicAc::calcChecksum(const uint8_t *state, const uint16_t length = kPanasonicAcStateLength)
functions.description: Compute the Panasonic A/C checksum value over a state buffer.
requirements: state must point to at least length bytes and must not be null.
length should be the actual message size (typically kPanasonicAcStateLength).

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::setQuiet

requirements: on == true enables Quiet mode; false disables it.
Does not transmit; call send() to emit.
Model-specific bit placement may vary; setModel() should be correct for your remote to ensure proper behavior.

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::getQuiet

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::setPowerful

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::getPowerful

functions.name: IRPanasonicAc::getSwingHorizontal

requirements: pin must be a valid GPIO capable of driving the IR LED for the target platform (per IRremoteESP8266/IRsend requirements).
If inverted is true, the output signal logic is inverted (hardware-dependent).
If use_modulation is true, transmission uses carrier modulation (typically 38 kHz).

requirements: After resetting, any previously set custom state is lost.
Callers should set desired fields again (e.g., setTemp, setMode) before send() if defaults are not desired.

functions.name: IRRhossAc::send
functions.description: Transmits the currently stored Rhoss A/C IR message using the configured IR transmitter. Optionally repeats the transmission repeat times as per kRhossDefaultRepeat policy.
requirements: Available only when compiled with SEND_RHOSS enabled.
begin() must be called successfully before send().
repeat must be a finite, non-negative count; values are interpreted per library convention (typically number of repeats).
The internal state should represent the intended command; callers may call validChecksum(getRaw()) to verify state integrity if they modify raw bytes directly.

functions.name: IRRhossAc::calibrate
functions.description: Runs IR transmitter timing calibration for this object, returning the microsecond offset needed per modulation of the IR LED. Intended to be run once per object to improve timing accuracy. Emits a ~65 ms 38 kHz IR pulse during calibration.
requirements: Available only when compiled with SEND_RHOSS enabled.
Produces an IR output during calibration; ensure it will not undesirably affect nearby devices.
Run at most once per object instantiation unless re-calibration is required by the platform.

functions.name: IRRhossAc::begin
functions.description: Initializes underlying IR transmitter resources for this IRRhossAc instance so it can send IR messages.
requirements: Must be called before send().

functions.name: IRRhossAc::calcChecksum

functions.description: Computes the Rhoss protocol checksum byte over the provided state buffer. Use to generate or verify the checksum for a raw message.
requirements: state must be a valid non-null pointer to at least length bytes.
length should be kRhossStateLength for full Rhoss frames; using other lengths will compute over the first length bytes only.

functions.name: IRRhossAc::validChecksum

functions.description: Checks whether the checksum within the provided Rhoss protocol state buffer is valid for the given length.
requirements: state must be a valid non-null pointer to at least length bytes.
length should be kRhossStateLength for a full Rhoss message; partial lengths validate against the provided span.
The state buffer is expected to contain a checksum byte in its checksum field/location.

requirements: Available only if SEND_TCL112AC is defined at compile time.
begin() should be called prior to first send() to initialize the transmitter.

functions.description: Runs IR transmitter timing calibration and returns the per-modulation microsecond offset for accurate mark/space generation. Emits a ~65 ms 38 kHz pulse train during calibration. Only available when compiled with SEND_TCL112AC.
requirements: Available only if SEND_TCL112AC is defined at compile time.
Calling this is optional and typically done once per object instantiation if higher timing accuracy is needed.
Be aware that calibration produces a ~65 ms IR burst; avoid calling around IR-sensitive equipment unintentionally.

functions.description: Constructor for a Technibel A/C IR controller. Initializes the underlying IR sender on the specified GPIO pin, with optional signal inversion and carrier modulation control. Typical usage: construct once, call begin(), then set state and send.
requirements: Must be provided a valid GPIO pin number for the platform.
If inverted is true, hardware wiring must match an active-low IR LED driver.
use_modulation should typically be true for 38 kHz IR; disable only if you know the target accepts unmodulated signals.
Call begin() before attempting to transmit with send().

requirements: None beyond a valid IRTechnibelAc instance.

functions.name: IRTechnibelAc::send
functions.description: Transmit the currently configured Technibel A/C message via IR, repeating the frame the specified number of times. Only available when SEND_TECHNIBEL_AC is enabled at compile time.
requirements: Requires SEND_TECHNIBEL_AC to be defined at compile time.
begin() must have been called successfully prior to sending.
repeat should be a non-negative count; typical values are small integers. Exact default is defined elsewhere (kTechnibelAcDefaultRepeat).
Hardware must have an IR LED connected to the configured pin.

functions.name: IRTechnibelAc::calibrate
functions.description: Run IR carrier timing calibration for the current platform and IR LED drive to determine the microsecond timing offset per modulation. Produces approximately a 65 ms 38 kHz IR pulse train. Only available when SEND_TECHNIBEL_AC is enabled.
requirements: Requires SEND_TECHNIBEL_AC to be defined at compile time.
Emits a ~65 ms IR burst; ensure it will not disturb devices in the environment.
Should be run at most once per object instantiation unless conditions change.

functions.name: IRTechnibelAc::begin
functions.description: Initialize the underlying IR sender hardware (pin modes, timers, etc.). Call before sending any messages.
requirements: Must be called before send() or calibrate().
Should be called from a context where hardware peripherals (timers/GPIO) are available (e.g., after Arduino setup()).

functions.name: IRTechnibelAc::calcChecksum
functions.description: Compute the Technibel protocol checksum byte for the provided 64-bit raw state payload. Useful when building or validating frames externally.
requirements: Input state must be a 64-bit raw Technibel frame layout as defined by TechnibelProtocol.
Caller should apply the returned checksum to the appropriate Sum field if constructing a frame manually.

functions.name: IRTechnibelAc::validChecksum
functions.description: Validate that the checksum byte embedded in the provided 64-bit raw state matches the expected value for a Technibel frame.
requirements: Input state must be a full 64-bit Technibel frame with the checksum byte present in the Sum field.
Returns true only if the embedded checksum equals calcChecksum(state).
